# Solution Baseline

Use this skill when freezing a complete solution package.

## Procedure

1. Inventory source artifacts and versions.
2. Confirm requirement and architecture freeze readiness.
3. Confirm blocker questions are resolved or explicitly accepted.
4. Confirm review corrections are applied.
5. Ask for explicit approval.
6. Create baseline and change-control notes.

**Why?** The final baseline becomes the source of truth for build and implementation.
